__note: Reviewed rename worklist for roadster-flying-car (PLAN §5 campaign). ROADSTER's inline module script is AUTHORED, not minified: of the 693 program-scope bindings of the app chunk, most already carry the author's own semantic names (renderer, scene, camera, car, body, wheels, mission, composer, …) and are left untouched — renaming them would destroy the author's naming, not recover it. This worklist renames only the genuinely opaque short bindings (single-letter globals, two/three-letter code abbreviations, the `_`-prefixed scratch family). Every rule is evidence-based: the note names the declaration/comment this rule was authored from (line numbers refer to readable/index-inline-1.pretty.js at the 2026-10-13 capture). Targets must not collide with an existing chunk-scope binding or a free/global name; tools/apply-names.mjs refuses collisions, shorthand positions, and chained renames, and tools/verify-rename.mjs + tools/check-chunk.mjs prove the result. The vendor `__defs`/`__req` loader and the twelve three.js r187dev module factories are wholeFile and never candidates (the three refused names in `apply-names --list`). Every refusal the writer made is recorded with its exact preflight reason in the `refused` section below — a refusal is a result, not a failure, and no guard was weakened to avoid one.
